# Close wrap — Thu 2026-11-26 (Thanksgiving)

**US stocks and bonds CLOSED.** No cash session, so there are no index, sector, or covered-ticker closes and no after-hours earnings. CME equity futures halted at 1:00 PM ET and reopen at 6:00 PM ET, trading as part of Friday's date. Friday: stocks close at 1:00 PM, CME at 1:15 PM, bonds at 2:00 PM. [QuantVPS hours](https://www.quantvps.com/market-hours) · [LPF/CME](https://lpfutures.com/thanksgiving-2026-futures-trading-hours/)

**Holiday futures:** ES +0.74% (~7,248.75) and NQ nearly +1%, following Wednesday's reversal (Nasdaq -4.6% intraday to -0.62% at the close; Dow +0.33% after an ~1,100-pt drop). [X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2125947310953697301)

**Crypto:** BTC briefly hit $61K and then fell back under $60K. US spot BTC ETFs had a record -$453M outflow on 11/25, taking November to -$5.39B. [X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2125660854225957171)

**Setup for Fri 11/27:** a thin half day with Black Friday retail headlines in focus (BBY, DLTR, TGT, TJX holds also carry the 11/25 tariff-plan risk). The AI-hardware/semis group avoid stays in place until the 11/30 close review. Mon 11/30: MSCI review effective after the close. CRM reports 12/2 AMC.

**Ideas:** none. The market was closed, the next session is a thin half day, and the tape is coming off a shock reversal (lessons 11/06, 10/23). Existing swing ideas and avoids are unchanged.
